# aurora.lol

> Neon glassmorphic link-in-bio profiles with music, live Discord status, custom links, and a guestbook.

aurora.lol lets anyone create a glowing personal profile page at aurora.lol/username. Profiles support background effects (particles, aurora, stars, matrix), background music with a visualizer, live Discord presence via Lanyard, custom links, and visitor reviews.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What aurora.lol is and example profiles.
